label: Teltonika TSF000
description: A low-profile switch for tight industrial spaces: five Ethernet ports, four of them PoE+ with a 120 W budget, in a flat housing.
notes: Vendor figures (Teltonika wiki): 4 x PoE+ outputs with a 120 W power budget, 5 x Ethernet ports total, low-profile housing, DIN rail mount, unmanaged. eth0 carries no PoE because the PoE budget is stated for four outputs.
